precedence: Gaia DR3 exact-ID radial velocity fallback
radialVelocityPolicy.resolvedComponents: After aggregate splitting, reviewed systemic RVs can fill withheld motion as an explicitly documented bulk-motion approximation; no individual orbital velocities are supplied.
radialVelocityPolicy.review: Gaia DR3 fallback measurements are source-backed and retain uncertainty and quality flags, but are not individually reviewed for systemic binary motion.
radialVelocityPolicy.systems: New members of CNS5 multiple systems share one systemic velocity, preferring a curated member, then the primary, then the smallest radial-velocity uncertainty.
radialVelocityPolicy.whiteDwarfs: Withhold new spectroscopic radial velocities because gravitational redshift may contaminate space motion.
